hook_text: Minus 15%, then plus 15%. You're back where you started... right? WRONG.
clip_script: Pause on the classic error before we celebrate. Many learners compute 15 percent of the original R850 for both steps: minus R127,50, plus R127,50 — and declare the final price R850, because they cancel. They do not cancel. The discount acted on R850, but the VAT acted on the smaller R722,50 — so the VAT added back less than the discount removed. Percentages of different amounts are different amounts of money, even when the percentage rate looks identical. Down-then-up by the same rate always lands you slightly below where you started, because the increase works on a smaller base.
visual_style: Price tag animation: R850 shrinking with a red -15% stamp, then growing with a green +15% stamp but visibly failing to reach the original height, gap highlighted.
pacing: Confident setup of the trap, dramatic reveal, brisk explanation.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master multipliers and never fall for it again.
